APOLLO:

posts.text: More unsound attacks on journalists covering the Fed. Powell got it right: "The Fed’s work is only as effective as the public’s understanding of it, and you, the press, are essential to keeping the public informed about what we do and why. The people we serve benefit from your careful reporting.”
